submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 at a threshold of 30 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency (92.241%) among all candidates and thresholds, meeting the project's goal of maximizing efficiency at the allocated trigger rate. This option is within the allowed threshold range (20-60 GeV) and, according to candidate_specs.md, is deployable in Level-1 trigger hardware. All constraints and goals are thus satisfied.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is among the listed candidates.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is documented as deployable in Level-1 trigger hardware per candidate_specs.md.
The recommended threshold is 30 GeV, which is within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 at 30 GeV achieves the highest observed signal efficiency (92.241%) across all options.
